name: Suite Room de Itazura na Kiss
original_name: スイートルームで悪戯なキス
source:
You work at Japan’s first hotel and casino. One day, you stumble upon a basement black market auction...and end up as one of the items for sale! The men who organize the auction place the winning bid, and your life with the rich and dangerous begins.

Life is full of surprises when you spend every day in a luxury suite. You’re at the mercy of the man who bought you; pretending to be his girlfriend at his beck and call day and night. You spend every day together, and eventually start to catch glimpses of the real him...

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voltage.g.suite.en&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
